entities.summary: Rini Mariani Soemarno is an Indonesian economist and was the Minister of State-Owned Enterprises in President Joko Widodo's Working Cabinet. She graduated from Wellesley College, Massachusetts, in 1981. She served as Minister of Industry and Trade in Megawati Sukarnoputri's Mutual Assistance Cabinet from 2001 to 2004.
